variants.headline: Looking back: shipbuilding for the colony route
variants.sub: Shipbuilding by the home world has provided a larger vessel or another vessel for the colony route.
variants.body:
We return to {first_reported}. Our report recorded this: The home world had built a larger ship or an additional ship for the colony route.

A larger vessel or an additional vessel should not be confused with an established volume of delivered freight. Commercial planning requires the distinction between physical provision and actual service. Managers should avoid converting this shipbuilding report into a precise change in supply, cost or delivery dates without the necessary particulars.

The event remains part of the record. Whether subsequent developments met the standard it raised is a separate question, not something the old headline can answer by itself.

We welcome {target} in this assessment. Construction for the route deserves recognition as a tangible development, even while a fair account keeps that achievement distinct from promises about voyages not established here.
